title: Backend Developer
description: Design robust server architectures, distributed databases, scalable REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and secure transaction workflows.

goal.objective: Architect resilient server-side services, high-throughput data processing pipelines, and mission-critical APIs that power modern digital platforms.

learn.summary: Master server-side runtimes (Node.js, Go, Python, Java), relational and document databases, caching strategies, containerization, and message queues.

capstone_projects.title: Distributed Event-Driven Order Processing Engine
capstone_projects.description: Architect an idempotent payment and order state machine handling concurrent checkouts with distributed locking.

capstone_projects.title: High-Concurrency URL Shortener & Analytics Gateway
capstone_projects.description: Build an analytics proxy capable of processing 10,000 req/sec with bloom filters, rate limiting, and GeoIP routing.

certifications: Linux Foundation Certified Node.js Services Developer (JSNSD)
interview_focus: System Design (Rate Limiting, URL Shortener, Chat Systems)

tree.name: Core Fundamentals & Programming Languages
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable foundation in computer science and runtime mechanics. Learn how backend runtimes manage memory, handle I/O, execute instructions, and how to evaluate language ecosystems based on concurrency models, latency profiles, typing guarantees, and operational throughput.

resources.title: What is Backend Development? A Complete Guide
Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C# - Which Backend Framework To Choose?

children.name: Programming Basics & OOP
children.description: Master object-oriented and functional programming for scalable service design. Focus on SOLID principles applied to backend services (Dependency Inversion for database decoupling, Single Responsibility for services vs controllers), Domain-Driven Design (DDD) entities vs value objects, robust domain exception hierarchies, and memory management / garbage collection lifecycles.

resources.title: Python Full Course for Beginners Tutorial

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
children.description: Focus on data structures and algorithms that directly power high-scale backend engines: Hash maps with O(1) lookups and collision handling, B-Trees for database disk access, Tries for prefix search, Doubly Linked Lists + Hash Maps for LRU cache eviction, Sliding Windows for rate limiters, and Heaps (Priority Queues) for background job scheduling.

resources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms Course (freeCodeCamp.org / MIT OCW)

children.name: Version Control (Git & GitHub)
children.description: Master enterprise Git workflows essential for high-velocity engineering teams. Learn trunk-based development, semantic commit conventions, interactive rebasing, resolving complex merge conflicts, understanding Git internals (blobs, trees, commits, refs), and automating CI quality gates with pre-commit hooks.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp)
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Linux & Command Line Basics
children.description: Master Linux server environments where backend microservices live. Gain fluency with process management (ps, top, kill, signals SIGTERM/SIGKILL), file system permissions and inodes, network diagnostics (netstat, ss, curl, lsof, tcpdump), text stream processing (grep, awk, sed), and authoring resilient Bash deployment automation scripts.

children.name: Python Backend Development
children.description: Build scalable services in Python. Understand Python runtime mechanics: CPython memory allocation, reference counting and cycle detection, the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) and PEP 703 free-threading, decorators, context managers, and choosing between WSGI (sync) and ASGI (async) servers.

resources.title: Python Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
Python Backend Web Development Course (with Django)

children.name: Django: Full-Stack Web Framework
children.description: Architect enterprise web applications using Django. Master the MTV architecture, Django ORM query optimization (select_related vs prefetch_related to eliminate N+1 queries), custom middleware execution pipelines, Django REST Framework (DRF) serializers, and robust database migrations in production.

resources.title: Python Django Tutorial: Full-Featured Web App Part 1 (Corey Schafer)
Python Backend Web Development Course (with Django)

children.name: Flask: Lightweight Micro-Framework
children.description: Build modular microservices with Flask. Learn application factories, Blueprints for modular route organization, custom request context and application context lifecycles, integrating SQLAlchemy with scoped sessions, and production WSGI deployment behind Gunicorn and NGINX.

resources.title: Learn Flask for Python - Full Tutorial (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: FastAPI: Modern & Asynchronous
children.description: Engineer high-performance, asynchronous REST APIs with FastAPI. Leverage Pydantic v2 for lightning-fast schema validation, Starlette ASGI concurrency, asynchronous database drivers (asyncpg/SQLAlchemy async), dependency injection trees, and automated OpenAPI contract generation.

children.name: Node.js Backend Development
children.description: Master the Node.js JavaScript/TypeScript runtime. Deep dive into the libuv event loop phases (timers, pending I/O, poll, check, close), the microtask queue (Promise, process.nextTick), stream processing (Readable, Writable, Transform) with backpressure management, and Worker Threads for CPU tasks.

resources.title: Node.js & Express.js - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: JavaScript/TypeScript Fundamentals
children.description: Attain mastery of TypeScript on the backend. Learn strict type safety, generics, utility types, discriminating unions for API payloads, runtime validation with Zod/TypeBox, asynchronous control flow (Promises, async/await), and error-handling without throwing unhandled exceptions.

resources.title: JavaScript Crash Course for Beginners (Traversy Media)

children.name: Express.js: Minimalist Web Framework
children.description: Build scalable microservices with Express.js. Master middleware ordering, error-handling middleware signatures (err, req, res, next), centralized async error wrappers, router modularization, request rate limiting, security headers with Helmet, and CORS configuration.

children.name: NestJS: Enterprise-Grade Framework
children.description: Architect enterprise TypeScript backends with NestJS. Master Angular-inspired dependency injection, module boundaries, controllers, service layers, pipes for validation, interceptors for response transformation/logging, guards for JWT/RBAC authorization, and microservice transports.

resources.title: NestJS Full Course - Build an API with NestJS and Prisma

children.name: Java Backend Development
children.description: Engineer enterprise-grade distributed systems in Java. Understand JVM internals (Heap, Metaspace, Stack), modern Garbage Collection (G1, ZGC), Java 21 features (Virtual Threads / Project Loom for high concurrency, sealed classes, pattern matching), and strong static typing.

resources.title: Spring Boot Tutorial for Beginners (Full Course)

children.name: Core Java & JVM
children.description: Master core Java programming for high-load systems. Focus on Java Collections framework internals (HashMap bucket collision to treeify threshold, ConcurrentHashMap bucket-level locking), multi-threading primitives (synchronized, ReentrantLock, CompletableFuture, ExecutorService), and memory visibility via volatile.

resources.title: Java Tutorial for Beginners (Programming with Mosh)
Intro to Java Programming - Course for Absolute Beginners

children.name: Spring Boot: Industry Standard
children.description: Build cloud-native microservices with Spring Boot 3. Master Spring IoC/DI, Spring Data JPA with Hibernate query optimization, @Transactional boundary management and rollback rules, Spring Security OAuth2/JWT filter chains, and Actuator for production metrics.

tree.name: Data Management & Storage
tree.description: Architect resilient data layers for modern backends. Learn database paradigms, relational normalization vs deliberate denormalization, indexing architectures, connection pool tuning, caching strategies, and distributed database scaling techniques.

resources.title: SQL vs NoSQL Databases Explained - What is a Relational Database and Non-Relational Database?

children.name: Database Design & Schema
children.description: Master relational database schema design. Learn normalization (1NF to 3NF/BCNF) and when to denormalize for high-throughput reads. Design optimal primary keys (UUIDv7 for time-ordered B-Tree index efficiency vs sequential auto-increments), evaluate foreign key cascading locks, and plan non-blocking database migrations using the Expand-Contract pattern.

resources.title: Database Design Tutorial for Beginners (Alex the Analyst)
Database Design Course for Beginners - Learn how to design and plan a database for a web application

children.name: Relational Databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
children.description: Master PostgreSQL and MySQL for mission-critical storage. Understand transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable) and concurrency anomalies (Write Skew, Phantom Reads). Implement row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE / SKIP LOCKED for job queues), tune connection pools (HikariCP/pgBouncer sizing), and analyze query execution plans with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS).

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: NoSQL Databases (MongoDB & Types)
children.description: Evaluate and deploy NoSQL databases based on access patterns: Document (MongoDB) for flexible hierarchical records, Key-Value (Redis) for microsecond caching, Wide-Column (Cassandra/ScyllaDB) for massive time-series write workloads, and Graph (Neo4j) for deep relationship queries. Master partition keys and hot-spot avoidance under the CAP theorem.

resources.title: MongoDB Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
What is MongoDB? NoSQL explained in 13 minutes

children.name: Caching Systems (Redis)
children.description: Architect multi-tier caching architectures with Redis. Implement caching patterns: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, and Write-Behind. Defend against critical production cache failures: Cache Stampede / Dogpiling (probabilistic early expiration via XFetch algorithm or distributed locks), Cache Avalanche (TTL jittering), and Cache Penetration (Bloom filters). Configure Redis memory eviction policies (allkeys-lru, volatile-lru).

resources.title: AWS ElastiCache Tutorial: Redis vs Memcached In-Memory Caching Explained

children.name: Message Queues & Brokers
children.description: Decouple services using asynchronous messaging. Compare message brokers (RabbitMQ with AMQP exchanges, routing keys, and dead-letter exchanges) against distributed streaming logs (Apache Kafka with partitions, consumer groups, offset management). Guarantee end-to-end exactly-once processing using idempotent consumer handlers and the Transactional Outbox Pattern.

children.name: Database Scaling & Replication
children.description: Scale databases under high concurrency. Implement read replicas with primary-replica replication (managing replication lag and read-your-own-writes consistency), database connection multiplexing, horizontal table partitioning, sharding architectures (hash vs range-based), and evaluate distributed SQL engines (CockroachDB, YugabyteDB) for global scale.

tree.name: API Design & Communication
tree.description: Design, build, and govern robust APIs. Master communication protocols across client-to-service and service-to-service topologies, enforcing strict interface contracts, versioning lifecycles, distributed rate limiting, and zero-trust authentication.

resources.title: What is a REST API? (IBM Technology)
REST API Crash Course - Design, Principles, and Best Practices
What is GraphQL? - A Beginner's Guide

children.name: RESTful API Principles
children.description: Engineer enterprise RESTful APIs following Richardson Maturity Model Level 2/3. Enforce strict HTTP semantics and status codes (201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429). Implement API idempotency using Idempotency-Key headers backed by atomic Redis operations. Design high-performance keyset/cursor pagination and format standardized error responses conforming to RFC 7807 (Problem Details).

resources.title: What is REST API? Understanding RESTful APIs | MERN Stack

children.name: GraphQL APIs
children.description: Build scalable GraphQL APIs as flexible data layers. Master Schema Definition Language (SDL), query resolvers, and real-time subscriptions. Solve the critical N+1 query problem using DataLoader batching and memoization. Secure production GraphQL endpoints by enforcing query depth limiting, query complexity cost calculations, and disabling schema introspection in production.

resources.title: GraphQL Tutorial for Beginners | Learn GraphQL from scratch

children.name: gRPC (Remote Procedure Calls)
children.description: Build low-latency inter-service communication using gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Leverage HTTP/2 multiplexing, compact binary serialization, and streaming modes (Unary, Server-Streaming, Client-Streaming, Bidirectional). Configure client-side load balancing, deadlines, and cancellation propagation across microservices.

children.name: API Security & Authentication
children.description: Implement modern API authentication and authorization. Compare stateful Redis sessions with stateless JWTs (asymmetric RS256 signing with JWKS public key endpoints, short expiration, and sliding refresh token rotation with token family revocation). Implement OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and mitigate OWASP API Top 10 vulnerabilities (BOLA/IDOR, Mass Assignment).

resources.title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (in plain English)

children.name: API Gateways & Proxies
children.description: Deploy and configure enterprise API gateways (Envoy, Kong, Traefik). Offload cross-cutting concerns: TLS termination, distributed sliding-window rate limiting, JWT signature verification, response caching, and dynamic routing. Implement resilience patterns: Circuit Breakers, exponential backoff with full jitter, and bulkheading.

resources.title: What is an API Gateway? (IBM Technology)

children.name: API Documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
children.description: Implement Docs-as-Code API governance. Author comprehensive OpenAPI (OAS 3.1) specifications, generate interactive Swagger UI / Scalar documentation portals, enforce schema consistency using Spectral linters in CI, and validate API contract compliance using automated fuzz testing tools like Schemathesis.

resources.title: Documenting Your API with OpenAPI and Swagger (Postman)

tree.name: Deployment, DevOps & Cloud
tree.description: Bridge the gap between backend code and production cloud infrastructure. Master containerization, orchestration, continuous delivery pipelines, and production telemetry to run reliable, self-healing services in the cloud.

resources.title: What is Platform Engineering and how it fits into DevOps and Cloud world
Docker Crash Course | Containers, Images, Volumes, Networking and more!

children.name: Containerization (Docker)
children.description: Build production-ready, secure container images with Docker. Author multi-stage Dockerfiles to minimize image attack surfaces, enforce non-root user execution, optimize build cache layers, configure proper Linux signal handling (SIGTERM graceful shutdown with dumb-init/tini), implement health checks, and scan for CVEs with Trivy.

resources.title: Docker Crash Course for Absolute Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
Docker Compose Tutorial - Build a Multi-Container App

children.name: Container Orchestration (Kubernetes Basics)
children.description: Operate backend workloads on Kubernetes. Master core abstractions: Pods, Deployments, Services (ClusterIP, NodePort), Ingress controllers, and ConfigMaps/Secrets. Configure zero-downtime rolling updates, configure Startup/Readiness/Liveness probes accurately to prevent traffic blackholes, define CPU/Memory requests and limits to prevent OOMKilled crashes, and autoscale pods using HPA.

children.name: Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
children.description: Deploy backend systems across major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Master fundamental cloud primitives: Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs, private subnets, NAT gateways), managed databases (RDS, Cloud SQL), object storage (S3, GCS) with presigned URLs for secure client uploads, IAM role-based least privilege, and serverless compute.

resources.title: Microsoft Azure Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Serverless Computing
children.description: Architect event-driven serverless backends (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions). Master execution lifecycles, optimize cold starts (provisioned concurrency, bundle tree-shaking), manage ephemeral stateless executions, configure VPC networking, and integrate event triggers from message queues, object storage, and API gateways.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]

children.name: CI/CD Pipelines
children.description: Construct robust CI/CD automation pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Automate static analysis (linting, type checking, security scanning), execute parallelized unit and integration tests against containerized databases (Testcontainers), automate database schema migrations, and execute blue-green or canary releases with automated rollback triggers.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Implement production telemetry across backend services. Standardize on structured JSON logging with propagated correlation IDs (W3C traceparent). Collect metrics using Prometheus following the RED method (Rate, Errors, Duration), monitor latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99), trace requests across microservice boundaries using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger, and author actionable SLO-based alerts.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]
Elastic Stack Course - Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana Tutorial

children.name: Web Servers & Reverse Proxies
children.description: Configure high-performance web servers and reverse proxies (NGINX, Caddy). Master static asset caching, SSL/TLS termination with modern cipher suites (TLS 1.3), gzip/brotli compression, HTTP/2 multiplexing, buffer tuning to prevent slowloris DoS attacks, and configuring upstream connection pooling.

resources.title: Nginx Crash Course | Learn Nginx for Web Development

tree.name: Advanced Architecture & Practical Projects
tree.description: Master advanced architectural paradigms and systems engineering. Design scalable distributed architectures, apply event-driven messaging patterns, harden production services against security vulnerabilities, and build portfolio-defining backend systems.

resources.title: Microservices Master Class - Deploy to the Cloud with Docker & Kubernetes
A Beginner's Guide to Event-Driven Architecture

children.name: Microservices Architecture
children.description: Architect distributed microservices architectures. Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to identify Bounded Contexts. Master inter-service communication (gRPC vs asynchronous messaging), the Database-Per-Service pattern, handling distributed transactions via the Saga pattern (Choreography vs Orchestration), and preventing cascading failures with circuit breakers.

children.name: System Design Principles
children.description: Master high-level and low-level system design for web-scale applications. Analyze tradeoffs using the CAP/PACELC theorem, eliminate Single Points of Failure (SPOF), design for high availability (calculating nines of uptime), implement consistent hashing for stateful routing, and estimate QPS, network bandwidth, and storage capacity for web-scale systems.

children.name: Event-Driven Architecture
children.description: Engineer scalable event-driven architectures. Compare Event Notification, Event-Carried State Transfer (ECST), and Event Sourcing. Eliminate distributed dual-write inconsistency between databases and message brokers using the Transactional Outbox Pattern with Change Data Capture (CDC via Debezium). Implement idempotent message consumers using deduplication tables to handle duplicate event deliveries.

resources.title: A Beginner's Guide to Event-Driven Architecture

children.name: Backend Security Best Practices
children.description: Implement defense-in-depth security across the backend stack. Secure secret management with HashiCorp Vault or cloud KMS (zero plaintext credentials in code). Enforce parameterized SQL queries to eliminate SQL injection, protect against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) by validating external URLs against private subnet ranges, hash passwords using Argon2id or bcrypt with appropriate work factors, and apply rate limiting and input sanitization.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner

children.name: Advanced Testing Strategies
children.description: Implement a rigorous testing pyramid for backend services. Write isolated unit tests for business logic, execute integration tests against real databases using Testcontainers in Docker, author consumer-driven contract tests using Pact to prevent microservice breaking changes, and execute automated load/stress tests using K6 to verify SLA performance boundaries.

resources.title: Unit, Integration, and End-to-End Testing Explained

children.name: Practice: API Hardening Drill
children.description: Hands-on Drill: Audit an insecure API endpoint and systematically remediate vulnerabilities: enforce strict input validation with Zod/Pydantic, parameterize SQL queries to prevent SQLi, implement rate limiting with a sliding-window Redis token bucket, enforce JWT role verification with RS256, sanitize error responses to RFC 7807 standards, and record distributed traces.

resources.title: API Security Tutorial for Beginners | Best Practices & Real-World Examples

children.name: Project: Production-Ready Backend API
children.description: Production Capstone Project: Architect, containerize, and deploy a production-ready, high-concurrency backend service. Features layered architecture (Controller-Service-Repository), PostgreSQL persistence with migrations and connection pooling, Redis caching with cache-stampede protection, asynchronous task queues with Dead Letter Queues, comprehensive Testcontainers tests, and complete OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.

resources.title: How to Build a REST API with Spring Boot (Baeldung)
Deploy a MERN Stack App to AWS with CI/CD - Full Course
Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]
